summary:
Poznote is a self-hosted note-taking app. I signed in as maya and set that as the prelude, then saved 5 views.
1. note-workspace: the main three-column workspace. It has the icon rail, the folder tree with favorites, and an open Markdown note ("Live re-optimisation — API sketch") showing its toolbar, tags and a code block. It's opened directly at /index.php?workspace=Work&note=5. In the replay, the Projects folder in the tree shows collapsed instead of expanded. Slugs can't be overwritten, so I couldn't re-save it with the tree open.
2. tasks: task lists gathered from across notes, with progress bars.
3. settings: the My Account settings panel with the category sidebar.
4. diary: daily entries as cards grouped by month, with an outline panel (Personal workspace).
5. notes-manager: a list of all notes grouped by folder, with bulk-selection controls.
I left out three pages: the Dashboard (just 4 folder tiles), the Graph (a sparse dot cloud whose layout may change each load), and Tags/Shares/Trash (simple lists much like the ones already saved).
